name: Arrested passenger, Barcelona airport, 2019 (silhouette only)
depiction: The 65-year-old passenger from Bogota whom Spain's National Police arrested at Barcelona-El Prat airport in 2019 with a package of cocaine taped to his head under a toupee (police say). Charged, not convicted, as far as reports show. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette seen from behind or in profile: no face, no features; a plain jacket. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
